title: Annie: The Sun Will Come Out Tomorrow
imageHint: Broadway stage with red curly-haired girl in red dress, NYC skyline backdrop, golden spotlight
description: From Little Orphan Annie comic strip to Broadway sensation to beloved movie adaptations - explore the complete story of everyone's favorite optimistic orphan.

questions.question: What is Annie's most famous song that she sings about hope for the future?
acceptableAnswers: The sun will come out tomorrow
questions.explanation: Tomorrow is Annie's signature song, expressing her unwavering optimism that 'the sun will come out tomorrow' despite her difficult circumstances.

questions.question: What is the name of the wealthy businessman who adopts Annie?
questions.explanation: Oliver 'Daddy' Warbucks is the billionaire industrialist who initially invites Annie for a week but eventually adopts her permanently.

questions.question: What is the name of the cruel orphanage matron who mistreats the children?
questions.explanation: Miss Agatha Hannigan runs the Municipal Orphanage for Girls and is known for her harsh treatment of the children and her alcoholism.

questions.question: What breed of dog is Annie's loyal companion Sandy?
questions.explanation: Sandy is portrayed as a mixed-breed stray dog that Annie befriends. The original Broadway production used an Otterhound mix.

questions.question: What year did the original Annie musical premiere on Broadway?
questions.explanation: Annie opened at the Alvin Theatre on April 21, 1977, and ran for 2,377 performances, becoming one of the longest-running Broadway musicals.

questions.question: Who composed the music for Annie, including songs like 'Tomorrow' and 'Hard Knock Life'?
questions.explanation: Charles Strouse composed the music, with lyrics by Martin Charnin. Strouse was known for his work on Bye Bye Birdie and other Broadway hits.

questions.question: What is the name of Warbucks' faithful butler and bodyguard?
questions.explanation: Punjab is Warbucks' East Indian bodyguard and assistant, known for his martial arts skills and loyalty to both Warbucks and Annie.

questions.question: In what decade is Annie set?
questions.explanation: Annie is set in December 1933 during the Great Depression, which provides context for the economic hardship and Annie's optimistic message.

questions.question: What is the name of Annie's locket that contains a note from her parents?
questions.explanation: Annie has half of a silver locket with a note saying her parents will return for her. The other half would be with her parents as proof of identity.

questions.question: Who played Annie in the original 1982 movie directed by John Huston?
questions.explanation: Aileen Quinn was chosen from thousands of auditions to play Annie in the 1982 film adaptation, her first major acting role at age 10.

questions.question: What is the opening number sung by the orphans about their hard life?
questions.explanation: Hard Knock Life is the energetic opening number where the orphan girls sing about their difficult circumstances while doing chores.

questions.question: What fake names do Miss Hannigan's brother and his girlfriend use when pretending to be Annie's parents?
questions.explanation: Rooster Hannigan and Lily St. Regis pose as Ralph and Shirley Mudge to try to collect the reward money Warbucks offered for Annie's parents.

questions.question: What Tony Award did Annie win in 1977?
questions.explanation: Annie won seven Tony Awards in 1977, including Best Musical. It also won for Best Book, Best Original Score, and several other categories.

questions.question: What is the name of the original comic strip character that Annie was based on?
questions.explanation: Annie was based on Harold Gray's comic strip 'Little Orphan Annie' that ran from 1924 to 2010, though the musical took many creative liberties.

questions.question: What is the name of Warbucks' secretary who helps care for Annie?
questions.explanation: Grace Farrell is Warbucks' personal secretary who suggests inviting an orphan for Christmas and becomes a mother figure to Annie.

connections.trigger: Annie is one of Broadway's most beloved musicals with iconic songs
Set during the Great Depression, Annie's optimism contrasts with the era's struggles
